notes: Replace nulls only with measurements. Link kg includes installed components and screws. trunk_base INCLUDES the V4 body shell, boards, battery, XT60 and A010; jaw_soft INCLUDES the V4 head shells and mouth servo, NOT the jaw. Print g is recorded separately, never added twice. Servo kp in Nm/rad, kv in Nm s/rad, stall in Nm; delay_s is reported but NOT automatically simulated. Weights rescale existing inertia; COM/inertia still need CAD or measurement. No actuation is enabled by this file.
